resources.string: This is a terminal on the server, with the hub account\'s permissions.
Whatever you type runs on the hub\'s host as the hub\'s own user, in the profile\'s folder. Opening and closing a terminal is written to the logs.
This hub has no PTY: commands run and print, but there is no line editing and full-screen programs do not work.
A terminal nobody types in closes after %1$s minutes. At most %2$s are open at once.
%1$s terminals are open already. Close one first.
A new terminal starts in the %1$s profile\'s folder.
The terminal is not enabled on this hub.
It is off unless the hub is started with COREHUB_WEB_TERMINAL=1, and even then only the owner sees it.
This terminal is no longer on the hub.
